description: List currently supported ISO 4217 currency codes with full names and as_of, the latest served rate date. Use this to disambiguate dollars (USD vs AUD vs CAD). Historical availability is checked against the requested historical snapshot or range and can include retired currencies absent from current discovery.
name: fx_list_currencies

as_of.description: Latest served daily rate date for this current-discovery list; historical availability is checked against historical data.

currencies.description: All supported currencies, sorted alphabetically by code.

code.description: ISO 4217 currency code (e.g. USD, EUR, JPY).

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

source.description: Always "Frankfurter v1" — the upstream data provider.

title: Fx List Currencies
